title.zh: Tokenized stocks can carry the same rights without the same trading protections
title.en: Tokenized stocks can carry the same rights without the same trading protections

current_state.zh: An analysis of the SEC's tokenized-stock exemption finds that tokenized equities can confer the same ownership rights as conventional shares while lacking the same trading protections, since venues control key price-feed decisions.
current_state.en: An analysis of the SEC's tokenized-stock exemption finds that tokenized equities can confer the same ownership rights as conventional shares while lacking the same trading protections, since venues control key price-feed decisions.
